title: Ordering Multivariate Time Series by Volatility Memory: A Temporal Convolutional Approach to Volatility Heredity
abstract: arXiv:2611.07746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Volatility dynamics can carry information about temporal relationships that is not apparent in the conditional mean. Extracting this information is difficult because the persistence of each variable can obscure its dependence on other variables. This paper presents QS-TCN, a method for ordering multivariate time series that combines statistical estimates of volatility memory with temporal convolutional learning. Persistence estimates obtained by quasi-maximum likelihood and temporal modes extracted by the Matrix Pencil method define structured filters within the network. Together with learned filters, they represent the history of the target and support comparisons of directional evidence between variables. These comparisons are combined into a global order of precedence, which does not identify a causal graph. The method is evaluated on synthetic systems with linear and nonlinear volatility interactions and on the Finance and fMRI bench

translated_title: 基于波动率记忆的多变量时间序列排序：一种波动率遗传的时序卷积方法
translated_abstract: 波动率动态可以承载在条件均值中不明显的时序关系信息。由于每个变量自身的持续性可能会掩盖其对其他变量的依赖性，提取这些信息十分困难。本文提出了QS-TCN，这是一种对多变量时间序列进行排序的方法，它将波动率记忆的统计估计与时序卷积学习相结合。通过准极大似然获得的持续性估计与通过矩阵束方法提取的时序模式共同定义了网络内部的结构化滤波器。这些结构化滤波器与学习得到的滤波器一起表示目标变量的历史，并支持变量之间方向性证据的比较。这些比较结果被合并为一个全局的先后顺序，但该方法并不识别因果图。该方法在具有线性和非线性波动率交互的合成系统以及金融和fMRI基准数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出QS-TCN方法，将准极大似然估计的波动率持续性统计量与矩阵束方法提取的时序模式嵌入时序卷积网络的结构化滤波器中，从而基于波动率遗传关系对多变量时间序列进行全局排序。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QS-TCN, which embeds volatility persistence estimates from quasi-maximum likelihood and temporal modes from the Matrix Pencil method as structured filters in a temporal convolutional network, enabling a global ordering of multivariate time series based on volatility heredity without identifying a causal graph.
